svg.title: Breakthrough
svg.desc: Breakthrough measured battlefield. North is up. Arrows measure terrain edges and objective centers from table edges. Terrain labels give width by depth in inches. Escape across the full north edge; use the scenario’s points target.

g.text: Arrows: distance to edge or point. All measurements in inches.
Escape across the full north edge; use the scenario’s points target.
Terrain borders are exact. Patterns do not add obstacles.
